Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Sunita - 34 years, mother
Look: pink kurta, a long plait
3. Sanjay - 45 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt

Places

1. The classroom - a blackboard, benches
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The classroom - Day

[Kunal stands in the classroom. Sunita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Today feels like a good day."

[Kunal raises his hand to answer.]

Sanjay (excited): "Exactly right."

[Kunal writes on the blackboard.]

Sunita: "And then?"

[Kunal reads his book at his desk.]

Sunita: "Well done!"

[Kunal yawns in the class.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Kunal stands in the park. Sunita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "So, here we are!"

[Kunal plays cricket in the park.]

Sunita: "I'm ready!"

[Kunal feeds the birds.]

Sanjay (softly): "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Kunal stands in the living room. Sunita and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "What a nice place."

[Kunal takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Sunita: "One more time!"

[Kunal gulps down a glass of milk.]

Sunita: "Yes, all right."

[Kunal studies for his exam.]

Sanjay (softly): "That was such a fun day!"
